content_md: Can someone please explain to me why search sucks on Apple Music, Mail, Safari and Spotlight? They got the chip, data and the software. To me, it looks like all they have to do is really build the index, that people are already doing on GitHub, but they still can't even copy that? Is this some kind of organizational dysfunction?
